questions.prompt: Global settings.json has "tags": ["a", "b"]. A trusted project file has "tags": ["c"]. What is the result?
questions.explanation: A list from the project replaces the global list. Only defaultTools entries that start with + or - are the exception.

questions.prompt: The global defaultTools is ["read", "sql_schema", "sql_query"] and the trusted project has ["-read"]. What tools are active in that folder?
questions.explanation: An entry that starts with - changes the global list instead of replacing it. It removes read.

questions.prompt: Why does pi load project settings only when the project is trusted?
options: The project files can load code
The global file would be deleted otherwise
questions.explanation: Project settings, extensions, skills and prompts can load code, so pi asks for a yes or no first.
